message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. Noise complaints are typically handled by the **City of Atlanta Police Department** or the **Code Enforcement Division**, rather than a city council office. Here’s how you can do it:

| Method | How to File | Contact |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| **Online 311 Service** | Visit the City of Atlanta’s 311 portal and select “Noise Complaint.” You’ll be prompted to fill out a short form with details such as location, time, and description of the disturbance. | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 |
| **Phone** | Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line at **(404) 656‑4000** and ask to file a noise complaint. They will guide you through the process and may take your information over the phone. | (404) 656‑4000 |
| **Email** | Send an email to the Atlanta Police Department’s public safety email address with the subject “Noise Complaint” and include all relevant details. | publicsafety@atlantaga.gov |
| **In‑person** | Visit the nearest police precinct or the City Hall’s Code Enforcement office. Bring any documentation (e.g., photos, videos, timestamps) that supports your claim. | City Hall – 55 Marietta Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30303 |

### What Information to Provide
- **Exact location** (address or intersection)
- **Time and duration** of the noise
- **Type of noise** (construction, music, barking dogs, etc.)
- **Any evidence** (photos, videos, audio recordings)
- **Your contact information** (so the department can follow up)

### Follow‑up
After filing, the police or code enforcement team will investigate. If the complaint is verified, they may issue a warning or citation to the offending party. In some cases, repeated violations can lead to fines or other penalties.

If you’re dealing with a recurring problem, consider contacting the **Atlanta Neighborhood Watch** or local community groups—they often collaborate with city officials to address persistent noise issues.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like more detailed instructions on any specific method!
